set_aside.subject: project-create stage (6) failure aggregation
set_aside.text: “one with other facts refuses the create as a conflict, a refusal of stage (6) … Otherwise (6) a named customer that the same answer called erased, restricted or ended refuses it” conflicts with “Every refusal names every failure of its stage (A04 rule 6).”
set_aside.question: When a project create has both a request-id conflict and a named customer that is erased, restricted or ended, must the refusal name both stage (6) failures, or does the conflict suppress the customer failure?
options: Name both the request-id conflict and the customer eligibility failure
Name only the request-id conflict because the customer check is reached only “otherwise”
set_aside.default_guess: Name both failures, following A04 rule 6.

witness.initial: An existing project carries request id K with current facts different from a proposed create; Customer C exists and is restricted.
events: The owner submits a valid project create using request id K and naming Customer C.
module:projects compares the supplied facts with the existing project's current facts and finds a conflict.
module:projects has also obtained that Customer C is restricted.
outcomes: The refusal names only the request-id conflict because the customer refusal is under “Otherwise.”
The refusal names both the request-id conflict and the restricted-customer failure because both belong to stage (6).
witness.observer: The owner sees different failure details in the refusal.
